request.target_rationale: Invented variance ceilings for demonstrating joint constraints and resource tradeoffs. These are not biological minimum resolutions, clinical targets or AniBench 1/2 thresholds.

parameter_set: S in [0,A]; B=A-S. Plug-in A and v are fixed, not known truth.
scope: Bounded declared design grid; no global optimum or AniBench level attainment
